items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: I was with Jules Baduc... I played there with that... I played with Jules.

ctx.x: Yeah, you were at the Cotton Club?
I was with Jules Baduc. Jules Baduc. Yeah, Jules. Ray was at that time was with Crosby, Bob Crosby. Jules had a very good band down there on Bourbon Street.
